newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECHS, JORDAN SEEK DEEPER TRADE TIES.
newsitem.headline: CZECHS, JORDAN SEEK DEEPER TRADE TIES.

text.p: Jordan and the Czech Republic are seeking to intensify bilateral trade ties, Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus's office said after a meeting with Jordan's Crown Prince Hassan on Tuesday.
In a statement issued after the meeting, Klaus's spokesman Ivo Strejcek said the premier and prince "expressed their preparedness to intensify economic and business cooperation of both countries."
He said the leaders discussed "possibilities of estabilishing a wider dialogue and exchange of information in the political, cultural, and intellectual areas as a way to better mutual familiarity."
Crown Prince Hassan, brother of Jordan's King Hussein, is in the middle of a three-day official visit to the Czech Republic accompanied by his wife Princess Tharwat, daughter Rahma and son Rashed.

The family has received full state honours during the Czech stop on wider a European tour, including a colourful welcome at Prague Castle by President Vaclav Havel, and a visit to the national stud farm housing prime Arabian breeding stock at Kladruby.
